Overview

Regina is a city in Saskatchewan with a population of 215,000. The capital of Saskatchewan, a prairie city known for its legislative building, the RCMP training academy, and the Mosaic Stadium. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials.
